facts.fact: Côte d'Ivoire presented its national AI and data governance strategy on 13 March 2025 after eight months of preparation, and it was handed to the Prime Minister for government adoption and a later launch, with data governance described as a complementary component of the strategy.

facts.fact: The article says Côte d'Ivoire is accelerating deployment of its national AI and data governance strategy, and the Ministry of Digital Transition opened a call on 26 May 2026 for six senior posts to strengthen delivery of state digital projects; it gives no adoption or launch date for the strategy.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition presented the national data governance strategy, described as elaborated, to business leaders at the Cgeci on 14 May 2025 and asked the private sector to join its implementation; the article states no cabinet approval or launch.

facts.fact: The Prime Minister's foreword to the National Data Governance Strategy 2024-2030 (SNGD 2030) speaks of the official launch of the strategy by the government, after a participatory process begun in April 2024 with over 200 experts; the document gives no launch date, so the year is its published date, 2024.
